title: Emissions stuck if `Voter.notifyRewardAmount()` is called without voters
summary: _Resolved_  ## Severity  **Impact:** Medium  **Likelihood:** Medium  ## Description  In the `Voter` contract, the `notifyRewardAmount()` function allows anyone to donate `KITTEN` tokens for the current period, which are distributed among registered gauges based on their share of the total votes. This function is also invoked by `Minter.updatePeriod()` to mint and allocate emissions starting from the next epoch period after the `Voter.start()` call.
